##### Project General Facts

Nineteen Riviera Lagoon presents an extraordinary collection of villas, each meticulously designed to harmonize indoor and outdoor living spaces, thereby redefining the concept of luxurious residences. These opulent villas boast an impressive array of features, including a self-contained suite on the second floor, adorned with a bedroom, bathroom, terraces, and a private plunge pool, perfect for hosting discerning guests. The gated community is complemented by a serene community park, a grand entrance, and exquisite Italian kitchens, all carefully crafted to create an exclusive and refined environment.

Amenities at Nineteen Riviera Lagoon are characterized by an array of modern conveniences, including in-house elevators, indoor green spaces, and personalized interiors, all of which contribute to a truly unique and sophisticated living experience. Furthermore, the incorporation of outdoor showers and car washing bays underscores the meticulous attention to detail, while the ample parking facilities, accommodating seven to twelve vehicles per villa, as well as additional parking for numerous vehicles within the complex, ensure unparalleled convenience. The utilization of high-quality materials and panoramic glazing allows for an abundance of natural light, thereby creating a sense of airiness and expansiveness throughout the villas.

The villas at Nineteen Riviera Lagoon feature sumptuous master bedrooms, replete with extensive walk-in wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with Italian appliances from Miele and a Quooker tap, showcasing a perfect blend of form and function. The finishing options, available in Grey Riviera, Beige Riviera, or Versace Inspired finishes, demonstrate a commitment to elegance and refinement, while the decision to deliver properties unfurnished allows residents to imbue their homes with their own personal style. With such thoughtful design elements and luxurious amenities, Nineteen Riviera Lagoon sets a new standard for sophisticated living.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan South is a sought-after location, boasting a unique blend of natural beauty, modern amenities, and accessibility. The area is surrounded by a plethora of prestigious destinations, including the renowned Meydan Racecourse, home to the annual Dubai World Cup, which lends an air of excitement and glamour to the community. Top-tier educational institutions, such as North London Collegiate School and Kings' School, are also situated nearby, making Meydan South an attractive choice for families.

The region's strategic location ensures effortless access to key areas, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and Dubai Marina, thereby combining luxurious living with unparalleled convenience. Residents of Meydan South can enjoy a wide range of shopping, dining, and entertainment options, all while being surrounded by stunning natural landscapes and picturesque green spaces. The area's extensive array of recreational facilities, including the Nad Al Sheba Sports Complex, offers a diverse range of sports activities, from tennis and football to swimming, catering to a broad spectrum of interests and ages.

Meydan South's unique charm lies in its ability to balance tranquility and accessibility, making it an ideal location for those seeking a refined and relaxing lifestyle. The area's prestigious reputation, modern amenities, and stunning natural beauty all converge to create a truly exceptional living environment, one that is poised to meet the evolving needs of its discerning residents. With its exquisite blend of luxury, convenience, and natural beauty, Meydan South is undoubtedly a highly desirable destination, offering a unique and unparalleled quality of life.
